ideas.title: Investigating Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the prevalence of child care fraud in Minnesota and the efforts of lawmakers to address the issue.
questions: What is the scope of child care fraud in Minnesota?
How are lawmakers addressing the issue?
ideas.insight: I believe that child care fraud is a significant issue in Minnesota, and lawmakers are taking steps to address it. However, further investigation is needed to determine the effectiveness of these efforts and identify potential areas for improvement.
